associations.rationale: The equivalence states only the vanishing clause; it does not itself include the character and Weyl-dimension formulas also asserted by the theorem.
This is the complementary nonvanishing reformulation of the vanishing criterion; it is useful context but is a consequence rather than the displayed zero-if-and-only-if claim itself.
The type states only the Schur-character clause and does not itself include the vanishing criterion or dimension formula.
The type states only the Weyl-dimension clause and does not itself include the vanishing criterion or Schur-character formula.
This conjunction directly packages all three source assertions for a partition: the vanishing criterion and, when the number of parts is at most N, the Schur character and Weyl dimension formulas.
The type gives the dimension formula on the nonvanishing branch only, not the theorem's vanishing and character clauses.
This characterizes when the numerical finrank is zero; it follows from the module-vanishing statement in the finite-dimensional setting but does not itself state that the representation is zero.
The type gives the character formula on the nonvanishing branch only, not the theorem's vanishing and dimension clauses.
